notes.title: Seedlings 1 year anniversary update. Added 'Chapters'
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, thanks again for the support for Seedlings this last year. It's crazy to think that a year has passed already.

The most requested feature is finally here, A chapter select system you can access from the menu once you have completed the story. Now you can go back and get the collectables you missed on the first playthrough without having to go though the entire game again.

There's more that I will like to add in the future. I'm thinking of a challenge level that isn't part of the main game but something much more difficult using the rope mechanics. More on that later. I'm also working on a completely new game but haven't got anything ready to share for that yet.

Thanks again to everyone who has bought and played Seedlings this last year. I wanted to do something simple for my first game, and that ended up taking 5 years. Going back, I have learned so much from the whole experience. 

I'm glad that the people that have played it enjoyed it.
